animation: v3 custom (Mangnani basic attack: ONE broad, forceful HORIZONTAL CLEAVE across the THREE adjacent tiles immediately in front of his facing: front-left, front-center, front-right. The blade sweeps laterally across the entire forward row in one continuous waist-to-chest-height arc PARALLEL TO THE GROUND. Horizontal means the world-space cutting plane, viewed with the existing low top-down perspective, NOT a screen-horizontal stroke for every facing. Frames 1-2: plant feet and wind hips/shoulders with the execution cleaver drawn to one side at waist height. Frames 3-5: rotate hips and torso, sweep the full broad blade side-to-side through the forward half-plane, visibly crossing the center of the attack and reaching the opposite flank. Frames 6-8: follow through and recover to the ready stance. Keep the heavy cleaver readable and full length, continuous grip in the same anatomical weapon hand(s). This is a single lateral slash, NOT an overhead chop, diagonal downward cut, vertical slam, thrust, rising cut, full-body 360 spin, or rushing attack. Preserve EXACT source character identity, rugged hair, red/ivory clothes, palette, proportions, cleaver design and asymmetric equipment. Fixed low top-down camera and fixed actor origin; animate in place with feet planted apart, no root translation, no camera motion, no zoom, no rescaling. Crisp native pixel art, transparent background, enough canvas margin for the whole blade, no clipping. Only the character and held weapon: no added slash trails, crescents, glow, magic, blood, ground shadow, scenery, grid, target characters or text.)
